Subject: Technical onramp: seed credentials, allowlist and VPC peering kickoff

Hi Lisa,

Thanks for the time yesterday. Attached is a one-page MAP draft and a small CSV template for the IP allowlist to speed the network team handoff. Below is a proposed technical onramp sequence we recommend for a 3-week evaluation:

- Tue Sep 7: confirm org name, primary cloud region, and networking contact (you)
- Fri Sep 10: Redwood creates customer org and sends invitation + trial credits
- Mon Sep 13: API keys seeded (short-lived service keys) and basic smoke tests
- Tue Sep 14: IP allowlist entries applied by Novagen (we'll provide CSV)
- Fri Sep 17: VPC peering request filed and kickoff call with infra teams
- Wed Sep 22: UAT run (sample traffic, latency/cost snapshot)
- Thu Sep 30: target close / decision checkpoint

Can you confirm:
1) Final org name exactly as it should appear in our console
2) Networking contact for VPC peering + prefered region (we recommend us-west-2)
3) Whether you prefer ephemeral keys or a service account with rotation guidance

Attachments: MAP-Draft-v1.pdf (one-pager), network-allowlist-template.csv

I added a HubSpot deal for this (DEAL-5638) — I'll sync the milestones there. If those milestone dates don't work we can adjust; this is the tight timeline that keeps the evaluation meaningful.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- IP allowlist: Priyom attaching a filled allowlist_template.csv; please populate with the two ranges you sent and return it. Once returned we will push entries to the onboarding queue and email you a confirmation of propagation.
- VPC peering: confirmed we can peer to us-west-2. Naomi from networking will schedule the peering kickoff; please prepare your VPC ID and a short CIDR map for route table updates.

- Novagen (Tim): fill and return allowlist CSV by Sep 13
